contact_vis = False

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames

    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),

vis.AddSkyBox()

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# Initialize simulation frame counter s

step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs

    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

Create a PyChrono simulation featuring a Kraz vehicle with specified initial conditions and visualization settings. Set up a rigid terrain with defined friction and restitution. Initialize a driver system for vehicle control and create a real-time visualization using Irrlicht with camera settings and lighting. Implement a simulation loop that synchronizes and advances the vehicle, terrain, driver, and visual system at each timestep, maintaining real-time execution.
"""

```python
# Import necessary modules
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
sys = chrono.ChSystem()

# Create the Kraz vehicle
vehicle = veh.ChVehicleKraz()
vehicle.SetContactMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetSuspensionEnabled(True)
vehicle.SetSteeringEnabled(True)
vehicle.SetEngineEnabled(True)

# Set initial conditions for the vehicle
vehicle.SetChassisPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))
vehicle.SetChassisOrientation(chrono.Q_from_AngX(chrono.CH_C_PI_2))

# Add the vehicle to the system
sys.Add(vehicle)

# Create a rigid terrain
terrain = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(sys, 10, 1, 10, 1000, True, True)
terrain.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
terrain.SetMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())

# Set friction and restitution for the terrain
terrain.GetMaterial().SetFriction(0.8)
terrain.GetMaterial().SetRestitution(0.5)

# Add the terrain to the system
sys.Add(terrain)

# Create a driver system for vehicle control
driver = veh.ChIrrlichtDriver()
driver.SetVehicle(vehicle)
driver.SetSteeringGain(1.0)
driver.SetThrottleGain(1.0)
driver.SetBrakingGain(1.0)

# Create a real-time visualization using Irrlicht
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 5, -10))
vis.AddCameraTerrain(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 1, 0))
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetLogo("")

# Create a simulation loop
time = 0
dt = 0.01
while time < 10:
    # Synchronize and advance the vehicle, terrain, driver, and visual system
    vehicle.Synchronize(dt)
    terrain.Synchronize(dt)
    driver.Synchronize(dt)
    vis.Synchronize(dt)
    
    # Advance the simulation
    sys.DoStepDynamics(dt)
    
    # Update the visualization
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.DrawAll()
    vis.EndScene()
    
    # Increment time
    time += dt

# Clean up
sys = None
vehicle = None
terrain = None
driver = None
vis = None
```

    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Double lane change maneuver sequence
    if time >= lane_change_start_time and time < lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration:
        driver_inputs.steering = lane_change_direction * (time - lane_change_start_time) / lane_change_duration
    elif time >= lane_change_start_time + lane_change_duration and time < lane_change_start_time + 2 * lane_change_duration:
        driver_inputs.steering = -lane_change_direction * (time - lane_change_start_time - lane_change_duration) / lane_change_duration

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    step_number += 1

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
